editorial_checks: A short philosophical introduction and two real-case essays, not a parallel eight-essay retelling of the papers' fictional world. No invented scenes, dialogue, private thoughts or composite participants.
English independently written. Both Chinese scripts carry complete prose. The front-end text uses no dimensional labels or proposition numbers.

The introduction distinguishes an emergent market outcome from an attributable decision, accumulation from its use, exit from voice, securing a supply from protecting an incumbent, and reachable support from a sponsor's control over direction.
PetSmart repayment figures and collection counts are attributed to Colorado's complaint, not converted into trial findings. Training is not treated as universally useless or universally successful.

PetSmart's anniversary staircase is measured from academy start, not casually from hiring. Toolkit and no-toolkit amounts, resignation and dismissal, and the thirty-day due date remain distinct. No monthly linear reduction is invented.

A repayment obligation is not automatically equated with an express occupational noncompete. The employer's possible investment-protection reason is presented as a reason to consider, not falsely attributed to a verified PetSmart submission.

The filed November 2025 consent text records discontinuance years before effectiveness, expressly denies liability and does not adjudicate factual or legal disputes. Filing is not equated with judicial entry. The February 2026 announcement independently establishes the implementation account, not receipt by every worker.

Amazon's Buy Box/Featured Offer, Prime eligibility and FBA are explained separately. Alleged anti-discounting and multihoming effects remain attributed claims about the challenged arrangements, not universal current conditions.
Amazon's own optional-service, delivery-quality and low-price arguments are retained. No promotional performance percentage or redacted number is adopted.

The 2024 dismissal order is distinguished from a merits judgment; the federal and state-law outcomes are not flattened. The 30 October 2026 order is a procedural record, not substantive liability. Outcomes in other Amazon cases are not imported.

European Article 9 commitments are a separate proceeding, not an infringement finding or proof of American allegations. The Commission's official French explanation and Amazon's own European statement are identified accurately; the full decision was not available for exhaustive reading. Announcement is not an implementation audit.
Usable exit, remaining to question a rule, and scrutiny of external reviewers all remain in view. Neither company scale nor contractual assent alone settles the normative reading.
Future hospital and credit-rating essays are not represented as published. No placeholder links or new category numbers are introduced. The old SAE Economics entrance remains separate and unchanged.
